_instructions: PLACEHOLDER bible-visual.json for swing-shack. Fill in the TODO fields below to give the image gen layer real creative direction. The brand_dna.py module loads this file automatically — once you save changes, the next generation picks them up. See the TODO comments and structure of the example fields for what to write.
voice: Premium, confident, data-driven. Confident without being cocky. TrackMan-confident. JHB-original.
visual_philosophy: Moody indoor studio over flat studio white. In-the-moment swing/launch feels over posed product photography. Data overlays (TrackMan trail, club head, ball flight) over generic copy. Real Swing Shack energy over stock-photo golf energy.
look_and_feel_keywords: TODO: 5-10 adjectives that describe the Swing Shack look
Examples (delete and replace): moody, indoor, low-key lighting, deep teal, amber accent, motion blur, mid-swing, launch monitor glow, club-head detail, premium, JHB
negative_prompts: TODO: list of things the model must never produce for this brand
Examples (delete and replace): white seamless backgrounds, stock-photo smiles, generic golf landscape, cartoon illustration, watermarks, AI-fingerprint artefacts

archetype_preference._note: Which archetypes the brand leans into most. The image gen will prefer these when no archetype is specified. Keys are archetype IDs from visual-spec/archetypes.json.

subject_bias._note: Bias the model toward certain subjects (golf clubs, swing, sim bay, member moments, data) over others.
lean_toward: Examples: TrackMan launch monitor, mid-swing, club head close-up, sim bay, JHB skyline
lean_away: Examples: generic golf course landscape, lone golfer posed at sunset, stock-photo studio

typography_in_image._note: How text appears IN generated images (NOT in posts — that's a separate layer).
typography_in_image.preferred_fonts: TODO: e.g. 'Avenir Next Heavy Italic, GT Walsheim'
typography_in_image.rule: TODO: e.g. 'amber thin rule above quote text'

_todos_for_christelle: 1. Replace the TODO values in 'look_and_feel_keywords' with the real 5-10 adjectives that describe Swing Shack imagery
2. Replace TODO in 'negative_prompts' with the real list of things the model should never produce
3. Set 'archetype_preference.primary' and 'secondary' to the IDs of the 2 archetypes you use most (look in visual-spec/archetypes.json)
4. Fill in 'subject_bias.lean_toward' and 'lean_away' — what we want more of, what we want less of
5. Set 'typography_in_image' rules so the model knows how to lay out text when it includes any
6. Set '_placeholder' to false when done. Once false, the brand_dna layer will use the bible as the hard creative direction
7. Bump 'version' (e.g. to '1.0' or '1.0.0') so the nightshift knows to re-validate
